$comment: Central gameplay tag registry. See docs/tdd/06-data-schemas.md and docs/tdd/90-source-reconciliation.md C15. Governed by project/Config/Schema/tags.schema.json and validated by tools/validation/validate_registries.py. Every namespace a tag uses must be declared below: an undeclared first segment is a validation failure, not a new namespace, so a typo cannot quietly invent 'Charater.Player'.

namespaces.name: Ability
namespaces.description: Classifies an action from project/Assets/Data/Actions; used for cooldown grouping and authority checks.

namespaces.name: Character
namespaces.description: What kind of actor an entity is. Server-owned; presentation may read it, never set it.

namespaces.name: Damage
namespaces.description: The cause carried on a damage event, per the combat layer in docs/tdd/03-runtime-systems.md.

namespaces.name: Objective
namespaces.description: Objective kinds referenced by mission and objective data.

namespaces.name: Surface
namespaces.description: Material class of a world surface. Drives footstep and impact selection in presentation; never gameplay outcome.

namespaces.name: Team
namespaces.description: Relationship to the local player, resolved server-side.

namespaces.name: World
namespaces.description: Properties of a streaming cell or volume, per docs/tdd/03-runtime-systems.md.

tags.name: Ability.Interact
tags.description: Short, interruptible interaction with a world object.

tags.name: Ability.Movement
tags.description: Alters gait or traversal state; the one action class with approved client prediction.

tags.name: Ability.Support
tags.description: Affects another actor's state without a damage event.

tags.name: Character.AI
tags.description: Server-simulated non-player character.

tags.name: Character.Player
tags.description: Player-controlled character, local or remote.

tags.name: Damage.Environmental
tags.description: Caused by the world rather than an actor; has no attributing actor.

tags.name: Damage.Explosive
tags.description: Area effect with falloff; the falloff curve is a data asset.

tags.name: Damage.Impact
tags.description: Single-point damage resolved against the server's simulation view.

tags.name: Objective.Control
tags.description: Hold a volume for a duration.

tags.name: Objective.Extract
tags.description: Reach an exit volume with a required state.

tags.name: Objective.Reach
tags.description: Enter a target volume once.

tags.name: Surface.Concrete
tags.description: Hard mineral surface.

tags.name: Surface.Metal
tags.description: Hard metallic surface.

tags.name: Surface.Soft
tags.description: Soil, sand, fabric: absorbs impact audio.

tags.name: Surface.Water
tags.description: Standing or flowing water volume surface.

tags.name: Surface.Wood
tags.description: Hard organic surface.

tags.name: Team.Friendly
tags.description: Same team as the observing player.

tags.name: Team.Hostile
tags.description: Opposing team.

tags.name: Team.Neutral
tags.description: Neither; cannot be damaged by or damage players.

tags.name: World.Exterior
tags.description: Open cell; full streaming radius and sky lighting apply.

tags.name: World.Interior
tags.description: Enclosed cell; reduced streaming radius and interior reverb.
